outcome.note: FIRST scout in the campaign with ZERO node failures — clean 4-of-4 run.

interpretation:
Clean execution + valid submission, but no medal. Score 0.889 indicates the router's models produced workable but not winning solutions. Same image-natural stratum as L55/L57/L62 GOLD (aerial-cactus) and L61 none (dogs-vs-cats) — confirming stratum heterogeneity.

Clean execution is itself a finding: cassava-leaf-disease apparently doesn't trigger the agent into picking timm/sklearn-extras like other image tasks. Possibly the data is simpler / more tabular-friendly, or the safer budget caused different code choices.

campaign_extended_scorecard.image_natural_findings: 3 tasks tested: aerial-cactus GOLD x3 ($11-18), dogs-vs-cats none ($14), cassava-leaf none ($17), leaf-classification above_median ($10). Stratum is STRONGLY task-specific.

campaign_close_decision: L63 closes the extended campaign. Two more image-natural data points (cassava-leaf clean-fail, prior dogs-vs-cats env-degraded-fail) both confirm the family-level promotion is unjustified for image-natural. Per-task LLM routing remains the proper granularity.
